# Assets

The assets file (`assets.yaml` unless the manifest says otherwise) names the images and colours faces use. An image can be a sheet of equal tiles, given by `rows` and `cols`; a face then shows one tile, picked by number, by row and column, per component, or by the value of a die.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"assets"` | yes | Marks this file as the assets file. |
| `images` | map of text to [ImageAsset](#imageasset) |  | Images by name, for faces to refer to. |
| `colors` | map of text to text |  | Colours by name, usable anywhere a colour is expected. |

## ImageAsset

An image file, given as its path, or as `{ file, rows, cols }` to cut it into equal tiles, as on a sheet of cards or a die strip.

Type: text or object

### ImageAsset object form

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | text | yes | Path to the image, relative to the project folder. |
| `rows` | whole number > 0 |  | Rows of tiles the image is cut into. Default 1. |
| `cols` | whole number > 0 |  | Columns of tiles the image is cut into. Default 1. |

## Example

From `examples/harvest-moon/assets.yaml`:

```yaml
kind: assets
images:
  card-back: assets/card-back.svg
  board: assets/board.svg
  dice: { file: assets/dice.svg, rows: 2, cols: 3 }
colors:
  red: '#d94b3d'
  green: '#4a9b5f'
  gold: '#e2b33c'
  ink: '#222233'
```
